topic: Exploring the 2-adic Metric: A New Way to Measure Distance

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Usual Distance
lecture_lines: Standard distance makes small numbers near zero.
Euclidean metrics show 1/8 as very tiny.
A rabbit hops closer to zero point.
animations: Create Euclidean number line. Label point 0 in #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/rabbit.svg].
Highlight integers 2, 4, 8, 16 on the line in #FF0000.
Show distance between points shrinking as powers increase.
Draw vector arrows indicating length in #00FF00.
Fade out labels; highlight 0 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/rabbit.svg].

sections.title: Introducing the 2-adic Metric
lecture_lines: High powers of 2 mean smaller norms.
Compare 8 as tiny and 1/8 as large.
animations: Display prime p=2. Introduce valuation function v_2(x) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/calculator.svg].
Show powers of 2 as "close" to 0.
Highlight the 2-adic metric definition formula in #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].
Animate 2^k moving closer to 0 as k increases [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifyingglass.svg].
Place "2-adic distance" label in #FFFF00 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scale.svg].

sections.title: Infinite Sums and Convergence
lecture_lines: Convergence means terms approach zero in 2-adic.
Higher powers of 2 stabilize the series.
Adding powers of 2 creates binary towers.
animations: Visualize partial sums of the geometric series using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tower.svg] to represent the growing magnitude.
Highlight the series 1+2+4+8+... in #FFFFFF.
Animate terms accumulating towards infinity in Euclidean.
Contrast with 2-adic convergence towards a limit.
Highlight the 2-adic limit value -1 in #00FFFF using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tower.svg] as a marker for the stable point.

sections.title: Visualizing Divergence vs. Convergence
lecture_lines: Ultrametric inequality keeps triangles isosceles here.
animations: Split screen: Euclidean vs. 2-adic metrics.
Animate divergent path in Euclidean side (left) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] to visualize distance.
Animate convergent path in 2-adic side (right) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg] to visualize orientation.

sections.title: Conclusion and Summary
lecture_lines: Distance is a flexible, human-defined measurement.
Switching lenses reveals hidden number theory structures.
animations: Flash key terms: Valuation, Metric, Convergence.
Display the final 2-adic number space.
Fade all elements to black.
